docs.cookie: A consent notice with accept and decline buttons.
docs.newsletter: An email field and a button, inline, stacked or beside a picture.
docs.posts: Posts as a grid, a list or a magazine.
docs.postheader: Category, title, excerpt, author line and a wide cover.
docs.auth: Sign in, sign up and reset password.
docs.profile: Account settings: picture, name, email, bio and notifications.

docs.activity: Recent events as a timeline or a list.

docs.channels: Ways to get help: email, chat, docs.

docs.bento: Tiles of different sizes in one grid; the large tiles hold the main features.
docs.featuretabs: Features as tabs; the chosen one fills the panel beside or below the tab list.
docs.accordion: Features as a list of disclosures, the first one open, with an optional picture.
docs.sticky: A picture that stays in view beside a list of features. Following the section being read is a port contract (ScrollSpy).
docs.iconwall: Many small features as icons with a name: tiles or chips in three to six columns.
docs.beforeafter: Two sides of the same points: how it was and how it is, as two cards or as rows.
docs.proof: A bar of customer logos and a row of key figures together.
docs.videos: Customer videos as thumbnails with a play button. Playing is a port contract (VideoEmbed).
docs.compare: Plans, or a product and its rivals, in columns, and the features in rows; yes and no as marks.
docs.usage: A slider for how much is used and the price it gives. The estimate follows the slider; the page keeps the value.
docs.credits: One-off packs of credits with a price: tiles in two or four columns, or rows.
docs.pagehead: The head of an inner page: the heading, one sentence and an optional action.
docs.authpage: A whole sign-in page: the card beside a picture panel, on a tinted page, or alone; with any mode of the card.
docs.wizard: A sign-up in steps with a progress bar or a list of steps; back and next move between them.
docs.shell: The frame of a signed-in app with a first screen: a sidebar, a top bar, or three panes.
docs.overview: Counters, a chart and recent activity in one section.
docs.kanban: Work items in lanes with a count; cards with a tag and a person. Moving cards is a port contract (SortableList).
docs.sidenav: A vertical navigation with the brand on top and the user at the bottom: full, or icons only.
docs.bottomnav: An app-style tab bar for a phone: an icon over a name, the current tab marked.
docs.skeleton: Grey blocks in the shape of what is coming: cards, a list or an article.
docs.tour: One stop of a product tour: the explained element and a callout with the step, a sentence and buttons. Placing it on the real element is a port contract.
docs.videomodal: A dialog with a walkthrough video and an optional list of chapters. Opening and playing are port contracts.
docs.errorpage: A page for something that went wrong, such as a missing page: a code, a heading, a sentence and the way back.
docs.article: A long read in one reading column, or beside a table of contents that links to the sections.
docs.team: The people of a team as cards, a minimal grid, detailed cards, rows beside a picture or a directory.
docs.photos: Photos in a grid, a masonry, a mosaic, a featured picture with thumbnails, or cards.
docs.projects: Projects as cards, a compact grid, captions over pictures, a bento or a list beside a collage.
docs.jobs: Open jobs as cards, grouped by department, or as a table.
docs.aboutme: A personal about section beside a portrait: key facts or skills.
docs.about: The culture: a strip of pictures, figures and values.
docs.timeline: Milestones on a vertical line beside a picture, in a narrow column, or in a row.
docs.dashshell: Twelve frames of a signed-in app around empty cards: a top bar across the shell or over the content, with or without search; a wide, rail, collapsed, two-level or no sidebar, at the start or the end; a footer across the shell, under the content or none.
docs.herosplit: A split hero with figures, faces, small cards or a quote under the lead, beside a picture, a floating card, a picture grid or plan cards.
docs.faqsplit: Questions beside the heading, a help card, a picture or a finder, or as cards in three or four columns.
docs.ctaproof: A call to action with logos, features, figures, icon rows or delivery zones; centered or beside a picture.
docs.quotesplit: One quote beside a picture, a rating panel or over logo tiles; stacked quotes beside a picture; four compact quotes; figures over a featured quote and a stack.
docs.postsplit: Tags, reading figures and an author card with share and save over a wide cover; the author, figures, tags and actions beside the cover; or the facts and related reading beside it.
docs.footersplit: The brand with figures and a sitemap link over link-group cards; or a split beside a picture with points, link columns, a newsletter card, the contacts or the community channels.
docs.featuresplit: Features beside a picture: plain in two columns, as cards with actions, two figures over checked rows, or four metric cards with actions.
docs.pagetrail: Breadcrumbs over the badge, the heading and the lead; with one large figure, a note card or four key facts at the end.
docs.postshowcase: Four small post cards beside an intro with a view-all link; the first post in detail beside its picture; or cards with the text on a panel over the picture, in two or three columns.
docs.medialist: Four figures, figures with a featured review, numbered steps, the latest posts, topic rows, or contact buttons with support figures, beside a picture.
docs.featureshowcase: Cards with a picture on top and a read link, or with a muted glyph panel on top like an index of categories, in three or four columns.
docs.storytabs: Year tabs over the panel of the chosen year, or the heading beside a picture with arrows and one dot per step. Choosing a step is an event.
